items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: And I had Joe Newman on trumpet... these were some of my most memorable recordings

ctx.x: I'd like to hear about those Vanguard records.

Well, I made several Vanguard records, some of which were first with a trio, a trio of guitar, bass and drums. They were done with Skeeter Best, a very, very fine guitarist and Aaron Bell, who had played with Duke Ellington bass, and myself on piano. And we later incorporated some other musicians for later sessions, but it was fundamentally the trio session that I recorded first, you know. And I had on there some original songs, also, which I dedicated one of the numbers to my old friend Sonny Howard. I called it…

Now, I also made some recordings with -- featuring Coleman Hawkins on Vanguard label, and on this particular session I had Earl Warren on alto saxophone, one of the old Count Basie men who was such a great first saxophone player, and along with Benny Morton on the trombone, who had also been with Count Basie and a great trombonist. And I had Joe Newman on trumpet, and I had -- let's see, O. C. Johnson on drums, and -- oh, I had -- I can't name all these musicians, but these were some of my most memorable…
